original_description: Runs the session ritual of a repo's docs system and produces its artifacts: `/session start [PLAN-NNN]` and `/session continue [PLAN-NNN]` read the docs system in full (OVERVIEW, plan, PRD, the open docs/sessions/SES-NNN serving it, CONTEXT.md), join the session the plan part names or open one and mark the part in progress, and post a brief (`continue` alone asks which plan in progress); `/session entry` after every commit appends and fills the commit's entry, updates what it made stale (plan ticks, OVERVIEW, ADR, PRD, CONTEXT.md) and commits it as docs(session); `/session end` leaves the session open with a handoff; `/session close` closes a session whose Goal is done and marks its plan part done. Use at the start of a conversation in a repo with docs/sessions (or to set one up), after each commit, and before finishing — "catch me up", "record that commit", "write the handoff". Not for authoring an ADR, a PRD or CONTEXT.md, for changing the session tool itself, or for a changelog of recent commits.
best_description: Runs the session ritual of a repo's docs system: `/session start|continue [PLAN-NNN]` reads OVERVIEW, the plan, PRD, the open docs/sessions/SES-NNN serving it, and CONTEXT.md, joins or opens a session, marks the plan part in progress, and posts a brief. `/session entry` after every commit appends and fills the commit's log entry, updates whatever it made stale (plan ticks, OVERVIEW, ADR, PRD, CONTEXT.md), and commits as docs(session). `/session end` leaves the session open with a handoff; `/session close` closes a session whose Goal is done. Use at the start of a conversation in a repo with docs/sessions (or to set one up), after each commit, before finishing, and whenever the session gate/check flags an unfilled placeholder or a second open SES-NNN and you need to know whose it is or what to do about it — "catch me up", "record that commit", "write the handoff", "is this warning mine to fix". Not for authoring an ADR, PRD or CONTEXT.md by hand, changing the session tool itself, or a changelog of recent commits.
final_description: Use for the recurring session ritual in a repo tracking work under docs/sessions. At the start of a conversation catching up on project status, `/session start`/`continue` reads OVERVIEW, plan, PRD, and CONTEXT.md, joins or opens a session, and briefs where things stand. Right after every commit (including tagging/shipping a release), `/session entry` logs what happened and updates whatever plan/OVERVIEW/ADR/PRD doc went stale. Whenever a conversation is ending -- stepping away, wrapping up, going idle for days/weeks -- `/session end` writes a handoff so nothing slips through and the next conversation knows what to pick up first and what's unverified. `/session close` closes a session whose Goal is done. Also trigger when a session-check warning names an unfilled placeholder or a second open SES-NNN, unclear whose it is. Not for hand-authoring an ADR, PRD, or CONTEXT.md; not for changing the session tool's own code; not for a plain changelog of commits; not for wiring hooks/settings to automate this ritual.
